summary: Stablecoin Development Corp filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing unusual trading activity in its common stock on the NYSE American and making the statement required by Section 401(d) of the NYSE American Company Guide. The company said its inquiries found no corrective action appropriate and that it is unaware of any material non-public information or pending transaction involving the company, its stockholders, directors or officers that could explain the trading. No terms, advisors, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are stated; the filing is a routine unusual-activity statement, not a special situation, though further volatility or disclosure could follow.
